pipeline.consequence: Transfers dominate: the host-to-device and device-to-host copies are 94% of the pipeline's GPU time (H2D 57.7 ms at 12.0 GB/s, kernel 3.6 ms, D2H 1.7 ms). Overlapping three streams can only hide the kernel and the copy-back behind the input copy, which saved 6.9% of the serial wall time. The design consequence is that the archive should be copied to the card once and stay resident, with every analysis run in that one residency instead of streaming the data per analysis.
